summary: Verified P1 fix: cancelling a confirmed ABC Supply PO is blocked (backend 409) and the frontend swaps the normal Cancel button for a 'Contact ABC branch to cancel/change' info button. All 5 new pytest cases pass; frontend UI check passes on both a seeded draft ABC PO and a seeded confirmed ABC PO (MOCK-CONF-10004).
critical_code_review_comments: set_status guard in backend/routers/purchasing.py correctly checks status=='cancelled' AND integration_provider=='abc_supply' AND external_confirmation_number before raising 409 — precise and non-destructive.

PurchaseOrderDetail.jsx computes abcLocked = isAbc && !!po.external_confirmation_number and mutually excludes po-cancel vs po-abc-cancel-blocked; also correctly hides the blocked button when po.status is already cancelled or received.
seed_data_creation: Two POs created via API for UI verification: draft ABC PO c7d6a0b0-6dc2-4fee-95a3-9e436ce721c0 (no confirmation) and confirmed ABC PO 94148770-d5f9-45dd-b390-f3580dd0e42e (external_confirmation_number=MOCK-CONF-10004, status=ordered). Backend tests create their own throwaway POs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_abc_cancel_guard.py runs single-worker fine (pytest addopts overridden). Use submission_key=uuid4 hex when calling /abc-submit; /abc-submit-review does NOT return a submission_key so the client must generate one. Confirmed ABC PO transitions to status='ordered' after abc-submit.
rca of the issue: Original: POST /purchase-orders/{id}/status accepted status=cancelled for any PO, including ABC POs already confirmed at ABC. Since ABC's Order API exposes no cancellation endpoint, RoofSpan would show 'Cancelled' while ABC continued processing/delivering — a false-authority divergence. Fix (verified): set_status raises HTTPException(409, ...) if status=='cancelled' AND integration_provider=='abc_supply' AND external_confirmation_number is set; PO row is not mutated. Frontend PurchaseOrderDetail hides po-cancel and renders po-abc-cancel-blocked (toast guidance) when abcLocked.
